data.name: Rags 2 Riches
data.detailed_description:
Core Features

🏗️ Base Building and Ownership

Use an advanced building system inspired by survival classics. Build shelters, fortresses, and defensive outposts with modular construction tools.
Secure your property using locks, permissions, and upgrade tiers that reinforce your claim.

🚗 Vehicles With Real Physics

Find, repair, and own drivable vehicles across the island.
Each vehicle saves its ownership, location, and condition — even after you log out.
Customize your ride, manage its health, and protect it from raiders.
(And if it flips — don’t worry, you can flip it back with realistic physics!)

💥 Combat and Survival

Balance your needs: Health, Hunger, Thirst, Oxygen, Stamina, Weight — every decision counts.
Craft weapons, scavenge parts, and defend yourself against both NPC threats and rival survivors.

🧰 Dynamic Crafting and Economy

Scavenge materials to craft weapons, armor, and tools.
Establish trade routes or run your own black-market shop.
From rags to riches, your economy is built entirely by player action.

🌍 Persistent Multiplayer World

Play solo or join others on hosted servers.
Each player’s world data — inventory, vehicle, and structures — is persistently saved.
Whether you want to cooperate or compete, the choice is yours.

🧬 Character Customization

Design your survivor from head to toe.
Customize your appearance before stepping into the world — your look is tied to your identity and saved for future sessions.

🌀 Destruction and Rebuilding

Vehicles can be destroyed, bases can fall, and empires can crumble.
But in Rags 2 Riches, rebuilding is part of the story. Every setback is another chance to adapt and rise again.

🔮 Planned Features (Roadmap Preview)

  • Player-owned shops and trade hubs

  • Expanded economy with in-game currency

  • Dedicated PvE and PvP zone separation

  • Advanced AI factions and bandits

  • Steam Achievements and Cloud Saves

  • Storyline and lore expansion tied to the island’s origin

🧱 Technical Info

  • Engine: Unreal Engine 5.4 (Source Build)

  • Gameplay: First/Third Person Hybrid

  • Modes: Singleplayer, Multiplayer (Client & Dedicated Server builds)

  • Platform: Windows (Steam)

  • Networking: Steam P2P & Dedicated Server support


About the Game

Rags 2 Riches is an open-world, multiplayer survival experience where every player begins with nothing and must fight, build, and trade their way to dominance.
Stranded on an isolated island, players must gather resources, craft tools, claim territory, and survive against the world’s elements — and each other.

In this dynamic sandbox, the line between scavenger and kingpin is razor-thin. Every tree cut, every bullet fired, and every alliance forged changes your story.

Build your empire, protect your vehicles and base, and carve your path from survivor… to ruler.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
